note: Per-guide budget of `no-check` code blocks with no recorded reason (```ts no-check -- <reason>). A no-check block silences the guide typecheck gate entirely, so a bare no-check with nothing after it must be spending down this frozen, file-scoped budget, not a fresh, unreviewed decision. The count may only go down; both an increase and an un-recorded decrease fail `pnpm typecheck:guides:no-check`. Run `pnpm typecheck:guides:no-check:update-baseline` to record a decrease (adding a reason, or removing the block, both shrink it). A guide with no such blocks is absent from this file.
